text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "Osaka Hai"... That has a real "JYVE" 
for Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“No ‘planetary occultation’ is occurring. 
—Not for any dwarf planet or minor 
celestial body.”
choice_data_list: Yeah, the conditions are a perfect match.
Yeah, the conditions are a perfect match.

text_block_list.text:
2000m on turf. That's one of the 
conditions best suited to Neo Universe.

"Even as I look at her hopeful expression, 
what comes to mind ...is still that 
disappearance incident."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring). Neo Universe 
suffers a crushing defeat in 10th place. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ""NIZR". —"Disappearing"."

"Drawing nearer moment by moment—the time 
of 'disappearance.' Still, vanishing so 
suddenly is just..."
choice_data_list:
No matter how you look at it, something's 
off...

text_block_list.text:
"On top of being physically unnatural, 
what feels even more out of place is..."
choice_data_list:
Hey, you can't actually see the moment it 
disappears, right?

Hey, you can't see the exact moment it 
disappears, right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: In that instant...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative. Yes.

"If it's going to disappear, I should be 
able to see what happens the moment it 
does. And yet, I can't."

At the very least, there was one thing 
that was crystal clear. And that was...

That "it wasn't an accident during the 
race."

"According to Neo Universe, she finished 
10th in the Tenno Sho (Spring). She 
completed the race properly."
And then, after the race...
choice_data_list:
You don't really seem like the type to 
take a break or retire, huh?

You don't really seem like the type to 
take a break or retire, do you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Affirmative.

"Neo Universe disappears truly out of 
nowhere. A literal 'disappearance.'"

—The mystery only deepens. Stepping back 
from Neo Universe herself to look at the 
bigger picture...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The “Great King” and the “Singularity”... 
Two entities that manifest after the 
disappearance...
choice_data_list: You can see that, can't you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: âI can see it.

"Neo Universe can also see the threat that 
will emerge after the disappearance."
No, it's not just these two specimens.

What lies ahead for Zenno Rob Roy is also 
visible.

"Swallowed by the massive wave of the next 
generation. And yet..."

"Only Neo Universe is nowhere to be seen. 
If so, the reason is probably..."

Zenno Rob Roy said that if your lens is 
clouded, you might not see what is right 
before your eyes, even if it truly exists.

In this case, what corresponds to that 
"peep hole" is...
"Neo Universe's eyes. These—azure pupils."

"The only window through which we can peer 
into that other universe. Information is 
being blocked along that path."

Then—why? Why is it that in Neo Universe's 
eyes, only Neo Universe cannot be seen?

And it's not like you can't see it all the 
time. It just suddenly disappears after 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).

"Something is there... Something is about 
to happen... The cause lies somewhere... 
within Neo Universe's inner universe..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe is departing.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to accelerate toward the "GATE". 
And then—the "FELT" of happiness."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If you let it slip, it turns into 
'loneliness.' The "guiding light" will 
drift further away.

As I watched their back walking toward the 
paddock...

A strange feeling welled up inside me. 
This sensation—this sense of anticipation 
is—

—Familiarity. No, there's no way I could 
know it. Yet, it somehow feels 
nostalgic...

Or perhaps, if Neo Universe's presence 
also exists in another universe...

――Neo Universe, aiming for a long-awaited 
victory. And the someone supporting her 
challenge...

In other words, an existence like "myself" 
might exist in another universe as well. 
That feeling...

It felt like it was flowing into me. 
Through Neo Universe.
There's no way to perceive it. Even so—

I felt it faintly. A "will" aiming in the 
exact same direction, residing in another 
universe.
